title: Programiz: Decimal to Binary Conversion
description: Given a non-negative integer `n`, return its binary representation as a string without leading '0b'.
constraints:
0 <= n <= 10^9
• Time: O(log N) | Space: O(log N)
solution:
def dec_to_bin(n: int) -> str:
    return bin(n)[2:]
explanation: Converts integer to binary format string in O(log N) time.
